chunks: 2698 - And Abdullah ibn Sinan said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
What do you say if I find a tick or a small parasite on me while I am in the state of ihram? Should I remove it from myself?
He said: “Yes, even their small ones, for they have climbed to a place other than where they belong.”

key_terms.أَطْرَحُهَا: I remove or cast it off
key_terms.حَلَمَةً: a small parasitic creature found on the body
key_terms.قُرَادًا: a tick found on the body
key_terms.مَرْقَاهُمَا: their proper place of ascent or belonging
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a person in ihram remove ticks or small parasites from his body?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the muhrim during hajj or 'umrah. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام permits removing harmful parasites such as ticks or similar small creatures from the body, including their smaller ones, because they are present where they do not properly belong.
